name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior natural resource company focused on acquiring mineral properties and royalty interests in Nevada's Walker Lane gold trend. The company holds royalty interests and exploration earn-in agreements on multiple gold projects, including the Lapon Canyon Gold Project consisting of 96 unpatented lode mining claims in Nevada. Nevada Canyon Gold operates at the exploration stage, advancing its project portfolio while building a royalty and streaming asset base.
